The project's current claims table identifies these evidence limits:
- Terminal-reveal supervision: The registered test did not establish a benefit from reveal supervision. The container accuracy comparison remained imprecise at the registered margin. [Paired result](../evidence/learning-pilot-v3/primary-paired-supervision-test.json) · [Decision cost and communication](../evidence/learning-pilot-v3/primary-test-decision-cost.pdf)
- Witness selection controls: This is an exploratory replay of previously scored scenes under the original camera placements. Recency, random choice and calibration-based confidence each answered zero of 34 first container queries at N=8. The fixed-witness tie limits the claim about flexible witness selection. [Matched compact results](PRIMARY_MATCHED_COMPACT_RESULTS.md)
- Motor data and performance: The original two 0/10 outcomes remain archived. ACT did not pass its fitting gate for the full compact split. The simulated results do not establish physical motor competence. [Verified optimizer inventory](../evidence/learning-pilot-v3/training-inventory-final.json) · [Motor evidence](LEARNING_PILOT_2026-11-26.md)
- Physical observation and collection: Attended control and STOP verification remain required. Both mobile observation streams must be fresh before a distributed attempt. [Current observation receipt](../evidence/learning-pilot-v3/physical-live-readback-so101-window.json) · [Operator guide](OPERATOR_GUIDE.md)
